## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related issue

Link the issue this addresses, for example: Closes #10.

## Testing

Describe the manual checks you performed and their results. See the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/dongeerts/replacinator/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#test).

## Accessibility

For interface changes, describe keyboard, focus, contrast and screen reader checks against WCAG 2.2 AA. Otherwise, write "Not applicable".

## Screenshots

For visible changes, add screenshots if useful and describe them in text. Otherwise, remove this section.
